en: All essential steps are done. Stay the course: invest regularly, rebalance once a year.

en: {{months}} months of spending set aside, available now; goal: 3 to 6 months on passbook accounts.

en: The most flexible wrapper: taxation eases after 8 years, so open early, even with little.

en: Invest in equities through a PEA and ETFs

en: For the long term: a world ETF spreads over thousands of companies, and the PEA exempts gains after 5 years.

en: An automatic monthly contribution (“pay yourself first”) smooths entry points: {{months}} of the last 3 months.

en: Main home, rental or REITs: another asset class, often financed with a loan.
